sys_update_set.description: Complete Transformer Asset Manager with all remaining production components: (1) Form layouts for Transformer (5 sections: General Info, Electrical Specs, Installation & Location, Maintenance, embedded Maintenance Records list) and Maintenance Record (2 sections: Details, Findings), (2) List layouts for both tables with key columns, (3) UI Policies for decommissioned transformer read-only fields and under-maintenance warning message, (4) Data Policies enforcing mandatory name/type on transformers and mandatory transformer/type/date/technician on maintenance records, (5) Client Scripts for default operational status on new transformers and future-date validation on maintenance records.
sys_update_set.name: Checkpoint
